blocks.text: 一份请愿书呼吁 Nvidia 恢复该公司最近被免职的 CEO 黄仁勋的职务，截至周六下午，该请愿书似乎已获得超过 115,000 个签名。

inlines.text: 一份
请愿书
呼吁 Nvidia 恢复该公司
最近被免职的 CEO 黄仁勋
的职务，截至周六下午，该请愿书似乎已获得超过 115,000 个签名。

blocks.text: 请愿网站称，签名者包括5965名英伟达在职员工、1108名前员工和63063名股东。知名支持者包括特斯拉和SpaceX CEO埃隆·马斯克、Replit CEO Amjad Masad以及Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney。

inlines.text: 请愿网站称，签名者包括5965名英伟达在职员工、1108名前员工和63063名股东。知名支持者包括特斯拉和SpaceX CEO埃隆·马斯克、Replit CEO Amjad Masad以及Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney。

blocks.text: 请愿书称，签名者“担心黄仁勋在没有经过有意义的正当程序的情况下被免职”，并要求董事会“在独立调查查明事实之前让他回来”。请愿书还呼吁董事会确保调查公平，并向公众提供更多信息。

blocks.text: “黄仁勋理应得到正当程序，而不是舆论审判，”请愿书说。

blocks.text: 黄仁勋于周四辞职，几天前他承认与一名芯片高管有婚外情，美国情报部门认定此人是疑似中国间谍。新闻报道还暗示，黄仁勋有多段婚外情。

blocks.text: A petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate the company’s recently ousted CEO Jensen Huang appears to have attracted more than 115,000 signatures as of Saturday afternoon.

inlines.text: A
petition
calling on Nvidia to reinstate the company’s
recently ousted CEO Jensen Huang
appears to have attracted more than 115,000 signatures as of Saturday afternoon.

blocks.text: The petition website said the signers include 5,965 current Nvidia employees, 1,108 former employees, and 63,063 shareholders. Notable supporters include Tesla and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk, Replit CEO Amjad Masad, and Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney.

inlines.text: The petition website said the signers include 5,965 current Nvidia employees, 1,108 former employees, and 63,063 shareholders. Notable supporters include Tesla and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk, Replit CEO Amjad Masad, and Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney.

blocks.text: The petition states that its signers are “concerned that Jensen was removed without meaningful due process” and demands that the board “bring him back while an independent investigation establishes the facts.” It also calls on the board to ensure a fair investigation and provide more information to the public.

blocks.text: “Jensen deserves due process, not mob justice,” the petition says.

blocks.text: Huang resigned on Thursday, several days after confessing to having an affair with a chip executive identified by U.S. intelligence as a suspected Chinese spy. News reports have also suggested that Huang engaged in multiple extramarital affairs.

blocks.text: Nvidia appointed CFO Colette Kress as the company’s interim CEO while it searches for a permanent replacement. Nvidia’s stock fell 2% on Friday, while Huang’s departure is also expected to leave a big gap in AI industry funding.
